title: LibRI screening thresholds (the only LibRPA-side tunables)

libri_chi0_threshold_C.meaning: LibRI screening threshold for real-space triple coefficients in the response function (chi0).

libri_chi0_threshold_G.meaning: LibRI screening threshold for the real-space Green's function in chi0.

libri_exx_threshold_V.meaning: LibRI screening threshold for the Coulomb part of exact exchange.

libri_exx_threshold_C.meaning: LibRI screening threshold for real-space triple coefficients in exact exchange.

libri_exx_threshold_D.meaning: LibRI screening threshold for the D (density) part of exact exchange.

libri_g0w0_threshold_C.meaning: LibRI screening threshold for real-space triple coefficients in the GW self-energy.

libri_g0w0_threshold_G.meaning: LibRI screening threshold for the Green's function in the GW self-energy.

libri_g0w0_threshold_Wc.meaning: LibRI screening threshold for the screened Coulomb interaction Wc in GW.

adjust.symptom: LRI screening error is reported as large
adjust.effect: tightens screening and reduces the LibRI error at a larger computational cost
adjust.guard: change the family coherently and re-check the affected stage before touching the DFT-generation parameters

constraints: Defaults follow the oml contract values; the LibRPA documentation lists 0.0 defaults, so an input without explicit values may be less screened.
These are the only LibRPA-side tunables; everything else on the LibRPA side is workflow control.
